description: Experiment 1.1: caps at the random-init need (192 MC/enumerated, 256 purified). The only policy run (decided 2026-11-16). See ../PLAN.md.

fixed.reset_rule: alternating rows: reset k on the rung at (round(linspace(0,Lx-1,4))[k], row k mod 2)
fixed.ordering: column by column; per column all vertical edges then all horizontal edges

methods.enumerated: all 3^4 = 81 trajectories, coin weight outside amplitudes

walltime_note: From the Phase 1 A40 bench (timing/bench_A_*.csv, 10 trials) plus ~1.3-1.5x margin and compile. Measured: 4x3 MC n1 10.0 s/step, MC n8 19.5 s/step; 3x3 purified 75 s/step (~63 h, expected timeout); 4x3 enumerated OOM at compile (2 h job records it); 4x3 purified 82.5 s/step (not submitted: purified stops at 3x3). 3x3 MC/enumerated scaled from 4x3 by SVD count. 5x3+ are unmeasured guesses: each arm is submitted one size at a time and stops at its first failure. Sizes with no entry are refused by submit_all.sh until a walltime is added here.
